title: A Space website's Book and other owner links stay on the website, never Frequency

source.ref: Owner ruling 2026-10-07: 'When a user is on the website, they should never be re directed back to the main site for anything. The website is stand alone.' ADR-1723.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-07. THE CONSEQUENCE: on a Space website every Book button (header, hero, start card, session cards, closing band, the Contact form's thank-you) opened frequencylocal.com/spaces/<slug>/book, which asks the visitor to sign in to Frequency. THE FIX: siteLocalHref maps the Space's own Frequency paths onto the site (root to Home, a page to that page, Book and Contact to the site's Contact form, else a mail link) and drops any other Frequency path. FOLLOW-UPS: on-site booking for guests; unthemed blocks on custom pages; the host router's deep-path redirect.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('components/sites/house-home.tsx','utf8');const p=fs.readFileSync('components/sites/site-page.tsx','utf8');if(/spaceBase\}\/book/.test(h)||/appHref\(b\.buttonUrl/.test(h)||/appHref\(resolved\.href/.test(p)||!/siteLocalHref\(resolved\.href, links\)/.test(p)){console.error('LIVE-834: a website Book or owner link still points at Frequency');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails on main (Book links to Frequency); passes once this lands.
